Antidepressants have always had the opposite effect on me, though I've always heard it's conventional wisdom they act otherwise.

As a new physician, I can see how articles like this may be actually damaging. Insulin itself does cause weight gain, and I have had type 1 diabetic patients avoid using their insulin because it would make them gain weight. That is not a good mindset to spread, however. It is necessary to management of blood sugars and if these sugars are too high then it can cause other serious issues. It is true that weight loss may help with a Type 2 diabetic, however type 1 diabetes requires insulin because your body doesn't make any at all.

In short, overly vague articles make my brain hurt.
